package.name: moveit_teleop_ik
package.description:
Full inverse kinematics for teleoperation, as an alternative to moveit_servo.
Servo does differential IK: it inverts the Jacobian locally and HALTS when a joint reaches its bound. This package solves a constrained optimisation every frame instead, with joint limits as constraints, so the solver redistributes motion across the whole arm rather than stopping. That is the difference between an arm that jams at a limit and one that reconfigures.
Robot-agnostic: the kinematic chain, joint limits and nominal posture are all read from robot_description and robot_description_semantic at runtime.
